description: The GAR Atlas archive supplies global hazard, exposure and risk layers for research and reference. Its index includes flood, cyclone, earthquake and tsunami information, exposed economic stock and multi-hazard loss estimates. The resource is documented by United Nations disaster-risk programme, GAR Atlas archive. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: Provider terms permit non-commercial use subject to material-specific restrictions. Access is described as free. The platform was decommissioned in 2020. The data are retained for research and reference and will not be updated. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
